strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rewrite the Xia--Yan--Wainwright comparison to acknowledge its weighted bilinear pointwise scope, then state precisely that the new target is a joint K_n-dimensional multiplier law with reused-cell covariance for the Choi--Yuan estimator.

Define a variance-training cell set containing every (i,t) used by residual-square estimation, impose the error-tail and independence conditions there, and prove its relationship to Q_n before claiming uniform plug-in consistency.

Demote the covariance identity to a supporting lemma and make the root result carry a nontrivial uniform consequence, such as a verifiable covariance-estimation rate or a growing-K nondegenerate staircase family.
